component.$description: Component colour tokens: aliases into the palette tier (plus captured literals where 1.x derived or hardcoded values). Generated from packages/sdc/components/00-base/_variables.components.scss by build/extract-components.mjs; each token records its 1.x source variables under the io.civictheme.scss extension. Not emitted to Figma (plan §3.1 — palette variables only unless designers ask).
